entities.name: Adi ibn Hatim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adi ibn Hatim al-Tai was a leader of the Arab tribe of Tayy, and one of the companions of prophet Muhammad. He was the son of the poet Hatim al-Tai. Adi remained antagonistic to Islam for about twenty years until he converted to Islam in 630.
